channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Twice-daily radiation improves quality of life in lung cancer trial
item.description: Primary results from the NRG-LU005 study evaluating atezolizumab (Tecentriq) in lung cancer were previously reported.

item.title: Early statin use after type 2 diabetes diagnosis linked to lower dementia risk
item.description: A study presented at ESC Con... found that starting statins soon after a type 2 diabetes diagnosis was associated with a reduced risk of dementia.

item.title: Breast cancer survivors may safely stop heart medication, study suggests
item.description: Many breast cancer survivors with treatment-related heart problems can stop their medication once their heart function improves, according to research.

item.title: Cardiologist referrals improve cholesterol in prostate cancer patients, but not all may need it
item.description: A large international study found that men with prostate cancer, especially those on hormone therapy, have high heart disease risk; cardiologist referrals helped improve cholesterol levels.
